Under the general direction of the Director of the Resource Center for Family Focused Practice (RCFFP), the Fidelity Coach/Trainer provides implementation coaching, technical assistance, and training to county and provider agencies participating in the statewide High Fidelity Wraparound (HFW) initiative under BH-CONNECT. This position focuses on building workforce capacity, supporting fidelity to the HFW model, and strengthening provider performance through individualized coaching, curriculum delivery, and ongoing consultation. The Fidelity Coach/Trainer collaborates closely with Fidelity Reviewers to translate fidelity data into actionable improvement plans and works as part of a coordinated statewide Center of Excellence team.
30% - Implementation Support & Workforce Development
Applicants will be screened on a weekly basis. The position can be filled prior to the removal date.

20% - Meeting & Training Facilitation
